caption: The drawing features a repeating geometric and botanical pattern composed primarily of stylized flowers, foliage, birds, and sunburst motifs, rendered in solid red and dark blue colors against an off-white background. The upper and middle sections contain large, symmetrical arrangements of floral and leafy elements in alternating bands of blue and red. At the lower left corner is a rectangular panel bordered in red, containing text written in both blue and red, reading: "MADE BY ISAAC BROWN FOR SARAH M. DUNBAR 1845." Below the text, the year "1845" is prominently displayed in large red numerals. Adjacent to this panel are motifs of birds, standing on floral bases, depicted in red with contrasting details. The compositional layout is divided into rectangular blocks and bands, consistently alternating in color and featuring mirrored botanical and avian forms, creating a visually balanced and structured appearance.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
